source='''def transform(grid):
    a = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(a), len(a[0])
    sr, sc = next((r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if a[r][c] == 2)
    horizontal = sum(a[r][c] == 8 and a[r][c + 1] == 8 for r in range(h) for c in range(w - 1))
    vertical = sum(a[r][c] == 8 and a[r + 1][c] == 8 for r in range(h - 1) for c in range(w))
    if horizontal >= vertical:
        step, pos, active, n_axis, n_cross = (1 if sr < h // 2 else -1), sr, {sc}, h, w
        def value(t, p): return a[t][p]
        def paint(t, p):
            if a[t][p] != 8: a[t][p] = 2
    else:
        step, pos, active, n_axis, n_cross = (1 if sc < w // 2 else -1), sc, {sr}, w, h
        def value(t, p): return a[p][t]
        def paint(t, p):
            if a[p][t] != 8: a[p][t] = 2
    while 0 <= pos < n_axis and active:
        following = set()
        for p in sorted(active):
            if value(pos, p) != 8:
                paint(pos, p)
                following.add(p)
                continue
            lo = hi = p
            while lo > 0 and value(pos, lo - 1) == 8: lo -= 1
            while hi + 1 < n_cross and value(pos, hi + 1) == 8: hi += 1
            upstream = pos - step
            if 0 <= upstream < n_axis:
                for q in range(max(0, lo - 1), min(n_cross - 1, hi + 1) + 1):
                    paint(upstream, q)
            for q in (lo - 1, hi + 1):
                if 0 <= q < n_cross and value(pos, q) != 8:
                    paint(pos, q)
                    following.add(q)
        active = following
        pos += step
    return a
'''
